thesis: Serra Angel became Magic's first iconic efficient finisher by attacking and defending in the same turn, turning vigilance into a complete control-game plan.

playbook.role: Deploy Serra after stabilizing, then use vigilance to pressure life totals without reopening the battlefield. Protect it from unconditional removal rather than spending cards on small combat tricks.
